scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with a large fountain on the right side and a statue on the left side. The street is paved with gray stone and has a low wall on both sides. There are tall trees lining the street and buildings in the distance. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building on the right has a red brick facade with a stone base and a decorative archway. It has a small window on either side of the archway.
scene_analysis.materials: The building on the left has a cream-colored facade with a stone base and a statue on top. It is taller than the other buildings in the area.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a stop sign and a pedestrian crossing signal.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is made up of large stone slabs.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet and peaceful.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and cafes.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is clean and safe.
